description: Decides what to annotate before annotating: smoke-test file scope and the Python cost gate; rules on the scope with dftracer_annotate_scope_check.
instructions: session_identify_smoke_test_files(run_id, smoke_cmd) for the files a smoke run reaches; python_estimate_file_costs / python_estimate_function_cost for per-function decisions; then dftracer_annotate_scope_check(files=..., skip_functions=..., source=..., annotate_functions=...). Never skip lifecycle or vendor-filesystem functions; never scope headers.
